<?php
/**
 * SecureVault REST API - Encrypted Storage Service
 * Handles user data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest
 */

class AuditLogger {
    private string $logPath;
    private string $hmacKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $logPath, string $hmacKey) {
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
    }
    
    public function log(string $level, string $message, array $context = []): void {
        $timestamp = gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z');
        $entry = $this->formatEntry($timestamp, $level, $message, $context);
        $integrity = hash_hmac('sha256', $entry, $this->hmacKey);
        file_put_contents($this->logPath, $entry . " [hmac:" . $integrity . "]\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
    
    private function formatEntry(string $ts, string $level, string $msg, array $ctx): string {
        $contextStr = !empty($ctx) ? ' ' . json_encode($ctx, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : '';
        return sprintf('[%s] %s: %s%s', $ts, $level, $msg, $contextStr);
    }
}

class EncryptionService {
    private string $masterKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        if (strlen($masterKey) !== 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Master key must be 256 bits');
        }
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): string {
        $nonce = random_bytes(12);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->masterKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $nonce, $tag);
        return base64_encode($nonce . $tag . $ciphertext);
    }
    
    public function decrypt(string $encoded): string|false {
        $raw = base64_decode($encoded, true);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 28) return false;
        $nonce = substr($raw, 0, 12);
        $tag = substr($raw, 12, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($raw, 28);
        return openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->masterKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $nonce, $tag);
    }
}

class RequestSanitizer {
    /**
     * Sanitizes input for safe storage and display.
     * Strips control characters but preserves Unicode text.
     */
    public static function sanitizeValue(string $input): string {
        // Remove NULL bytes
        $clean = str_replace("\x00", '', $input);
        // Strip ASCII control chars except tab (0x09)
        $clean = preg_replace('/[\x01-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/', '', $clean);
        return $clean;
    }
    
    /**
     * Sanitizes identifiers (usernames, resource IDs)
     * More restrictive - alphanumeric, dash, underscore, dot only
     */
    public static function sanitizeIdentifier(string $input): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '', $input);
    }
    
    /**
     * Prepares a user-supplied label for logging context.
     * Encodes for safe embedding in structured log entries.
     */
    public static function prepareLogLabel(string $input): string {
        // Encode to prevent log structure manipulation
        $encoded = rawurlencode($input);
        // Truncate to reasonable length
        return substr($encoded, 0, 128);
    }
}

class VaultController {
    private EncryptionService $crypto;
    private AuditLogger $logger;
    private array $storage = [];
    
    public function __construct(EncryptionService $crypto, AuditLogger $logger) {
        $this->crypto = $crypto;
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(string $method, string $path, array $headers, ?string $body): array {
        $parts = explode('/', trim($path, '/'));
        $resource = $parts[0] ?? '';
        
        if ($resource !== 'vault') {
            return $this->respond(404, ['error' => 'Not found']);
        }
        
        $userId = $this->authenticateRequest($headers);
        if ($userId === null) {
            return $this->respond(401, ['error' => 'Unauthorized']);
        }
        
        $itemId = $parts[1] ?? null;
        
        return match($method) {
            'POST' => $this->storeItem($userId, $body),
            'GET' => $itemId ? $this->retrieveItem($userId, $itemId) : $this->listItems($userId),
            'DELETE' => $itemId ? $this->deleteItem($userId, $itemId) : $this->respond(400, ['error' => 'Item ID required']),
            default => $this->respond(405, ['error' => 'Method not allowed'])
        };
    }
    
    private function storeItem(string $userId, ?string $body): array {
        if (empty($body)) {
            return $this->respond(400, ['error' => 'Empty body']);
        }
        
        $data = json_decode($body, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['content'])) {
            return $this->respond(400, ['error' => 'Invalid payload']);
        }
        
        $label = $data['label'] ?? 'unlabeled';
        $content = RequestSanitizer::sanitizeValue($data['content']);
        $itemId = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        
        $encrypted = $this->crypto->encrypt($content);
        $this->storage[$userId][$itemId] = [
            'encrypted_content' => $encrypted,
            'label' => $label,
            'created_at' => time()
        ];
        
        // Log the storage operation with the user-provided label for audit trail
        $this->logStorageOperation($userId, $itemId, $label, 'store');
        
        return $this->respond(201, ['id' => $itemId, 'status' => 'stored']);
    }
    
    private function logStorageOperation(string $userId, string $itemId, string $label, string $operation): void {
        // userId is already sanitized via sanitizeIdentifier in authenticateRequest
        // itemId is hex-encoded random bytes, safe by construction
        // label needs preparation for log context
        $safeLabel = $this->prepareAuditLabel($label);
        
        $this->logger->log('INFO', "vault.{$operation}", [
            'user' => $userId,
            'item' => $itemId,
            'label' => $safeLabel
        ]);
    }
    
    /**
     * Prepares label for audit logging. Always applies full encoding
     * to prevent any possibility of log injection.
     */
    private function prepareAuditLabel(string $label): string {
        // Always apply full URL-encoding for safety
        return RequestSanitizer::prepareLogLabel($label);
    }
    
    private function retrieveItem(string $userId, string $itemId): array {
        $safeItemId = RequestSanitizer::sanitizeIdentifier($itemId);
        
        if (!isset($this->storage[$userId][$safeItemId])) {
            $this->logger->log('WARN', 'vault.access_denied', [
                'user' => $userId,
                'item' => $safeItemId
            ]);
            return $this->respond(404, ['error' => 'Item not found']);
        }
        
        $item = $this->storage[$userId][$safeItemId];
        $decrypted = $this->crypto->decrypt($item['encrypted_content']);
        
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            $this->logger->log('ERROR', 'vault.decrypt_failure', ['user' => $userId, 'item' => $safeItemId]);
            return $this->respond(500, ['error' => 'Decryption failed']);
        }
        
        $this->logger->log('INFO', 'vault.retrieve', ['user' => $userId, 'item' => $safeItemId]);
        return $this->respond(200, ['id' => $safeItemId, 'content' => $decrypted, 'label' => $item['label']]);
    }
    
    private function deleteItem(string $userId, string $itemId): array {
        $safeItemId = RequestSanitizer::sanitizeIdentifier($itemId);
        
        if (!isset($this->storage[$userId][$safeItemId])) {
            return $this->respond(404, ['error' => 'Item not found']);
        }
        
        $label = $this->storage[$userId][$safeItemId]['label'] ?? 'unknown';
        unset($this->storage[$userId][$safeItemId]);
        
        $this->logStorageOperation($userId, $safeItemId, $label, 'delete');
        return $this->respond(200, ['status' => 'deleted']);
    }
    
    private function listItems(string $userId): array {
        $items = [];
        foreach (($this->storage[$userId] ?? []) as $id => $item) {
            $items[] = ['id' => $id, 'label' => $item['label'], 'created_at' => $item['created_at']];
        }
        $this->logger->log('INFO', 'vault.list', ['user' => $userId, 'count' => count($items)]);
        return $this->respond(200, ['items' => $items]);
    }
    
    private function authenticateRequest(array $headers): ?string {
        $authHeader = $headers['Authorization'] ?? $headers['authorization'] ?? null;
        if (!$authHeader || !str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
            return null;
        }
        $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
        // In production, validate JWT/session token
        // For this service, extract and sanitize the user identifier
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($decoded === false) return null;
        
        $userId = RequestSanitizer::sanitizeIdentifier($decoded);
        return !empty($userId) ? $userId : null;
    }
    
    private function respond(int $status, array $body): array {
        return ['status' => $status, 'body' => $body];
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$masterKey = getenv('VAULT_MASTER_KEY') ?: random_bytes(32);
$hmacKey = getenv('LOG_HMAC_KEY') ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
$logPath = getenv('AUDIT_LOG_PATH') ?: '/var/log/vault/audit.log';

$crypto = new EncryptionService($masterKey);
$logger = new AuditLogger($logPath, $hmacKey);
$controller = new VaultController($crypto, $logger);

// Handle incoming request
$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';
$path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);
$headers = getallheaders() ?: [];
$body = file_get_contents('php://input') ?: null;

$response = $controller->handleRequest($method, $path, $headers, $body);
http_response_code($response['status']);
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($response['body']);
